designer.name: Elina Vale
designer.title: Graphic designer building identity systems that move like cinema.
designer.intro: A cross-disciplinary portfolio shaped around packaging, cultural campaigns, moving image, and tactile motion systems.
designer.about: The portfolio is structured as a design universe: a gallery of brand systems, launch visuals, and social campaigns staged as illuminated objects in orbit.
